qualification.details: Project Associate I (PAT-I): M.Sc. in Microbiology/ Environmental Sciences from a recognized university. Experience in EIA and field sampling with relation to marine and coastal environment is desirable. Field Assistant: B.Sc. in Zoology/ Microbiology/ Life Sciences/ Environmental Sciences from a recognized university. Rs. 25,000/ - + HRA for others. Field Assistant: Rs. 20,000 + HRA Senior Project Associate (Senior-PAT): Rs. 42,000+HRA

content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the CSIR CSMCRI Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/ salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: CSIR CSMCRI Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 1 for Project Associate I (PAT-I), 1 for Field Assistant and 1 for Senior Project Associate (Senior-PAT).

content_sections.heading: CSIR CSMCRI Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Project Associate I (PAT-I): M.Sc. in Microbiology/ Environmental Sciences from a recognized university. Experience in EIA and field sampling with relation to marine and coastal environment is desirable. Field Assistant: B.Sc. in Zoology/ Microbiology/ Life Sciences/ Environmental Sciences from a recognized university. Senior Project Associate (Senior-PAT): M.Sc. in Life Sciences and 3 years experience in research and development in industrial and academic institutions or science and technology organizations and scientific activities and services. Experience in data management and modelling of marine environment is desirable.

content_sections.heading: CSIR CSMCRI Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Project Associate I (PAT-I): Maximum age limit is 35 years. Field Assistant: Maximum age limit is 50 years. Senior Project Associate (Senior-PAT): Maximum age limit is 40 years. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: CSIR CSMCRI Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Project Associate I (PAT-I): Rs. 31,000/ - + HRA for candidates who have qualified CSIR-UGC/ ICAR/ ICMR NET incl. lectureship/ assistant professorship or GATE or have qualified National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments like DBT/ DST or equivalent and/ or their Agencies/ Institutions. Rs. 25,000/ - + HRA for others. Field Assistant: Rs. 20,000 + HRA Senior Project Associate (Senior-PAT): Rs. 42,000+HRA

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for CSIR CSMCRI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 23-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR CSMCRI recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the CSIR CSMCRI recruitment is 23rd September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate-I / Field Assistant / Senior Project Associate posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for these posts. The distribution for each specific post is mentioned in the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: For the Field Assistant post, candidates must possess a B.Sc. degree in Zoology, Microbiology, Life Sciences, or Environmental Sciences from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Field Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Field Assistant position is 50 years. There might be age relaxations applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Project Associate post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Senior Project Associate post is Rs. 42,000 per month plus HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via email. Candidates need to send their applications and documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for CSIR CSMCRI recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any of the posts. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these project-based positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will be based on an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q9. What is the location of CSIR CSMCRI?
faq.answer: CSIR CSMCRI is located in Bhavnagar, Gujarat, with the pincode 364002.
